Several statements are wrong or poorly grounded, and the next steps do not match the body.","problems":["Says the elevated 99215 share 'appears in every complexity band', but the 4-condition band is 28.6% and the bands are not compared with peers by band in a way that supports this wording; the band shares do exceed all-provider shares, so the claim is only loosely supported.","The 'routine diagnoses' characterization is weakly supported: the cited diagnoses are codes (J06.9, Z09, M54.50, R21). 'Rash' for C0083480 is not on the card, since R21 is the rash code, so this is a code interpretation not shown. 'Follow-up visits' for Z09 is a guess.","Says 'only one of the supported examples (C0083532) is a patient listed in the claim samples'. This is true for the claim itself, but C0083476, C0083497 and C0083707 do not appear in the samples at all, so the statement is muddled.","'40+ minutes' for C0083497 (41) and C0083532 (51) is slightly loose; 40 is flagged by the number check but is only a threshold phrase. C0083497 is not in the samples, so its support is not tied to a low-complexity claim.","The body recommends requesting charts for the low-complexity 99215 claims first, but the code-written next steps only say to request a larger sample of 99214 and 99215 claims and to re-screen. They name no specific claims, so the investigator must reconcile the two.","The claim that the 2 notes with no lab line suggest 'cloned or inflated notes' is speculative, though flagged as weak.","The cited claims are only the two generic examples (C0083453, C0083454).
